prompt:
Develop a powerful, web-based mind mapping and visual brainstorming tool as a personal alternative to MindMeister.
Key Features to Include:
1. Tech Stack: React with TypeScript, Vite for fast bundling, a canvas manipulation library (like Konva or React Flow), and IndexedDB for local-first storage with optional cloud sync.
2. Intuitive Visual Editor: Build an infinite canvas for creating radial mind maps. Include robust drag-and-drop mechanics, node resizing, auto-layout algorithms, and smooth connecting lines. 
3. Rich Customization: Allow users to personalize maps with different themes, colors, icons, font sizes, and structural layouts (radial, tree, org chart).
4. Task & Project Management: Enable users to convert nodes directly into actionable tasks. Add fields for assignees, due dates, and status checkboxes within the nodes themselves.
5. AI-Assisted Brainstorming: Integrate an optional AI API (like OpenAI) to auto-generate child nodes, brainstorm ideas, or summarize branches.
6. Presentation Mode: Implement a feature to seamlessly turn branches of the mind map into a slide-by-slide presentation.
7. Export & Import: Support exporting maps to high-quality SVG, PNG, and PDF, as well as importing from standard mind mapping formats (like OPML or FreeMind).
Keep the app highly polished, fully functional offline, and heavily reliant on keyboard shortcuts for power users. Skip enterprise role-based access, real-time multiplayer collaboration, and subscription plans.
